runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.unverifiedHint: The files this run executed differ from the version DevDigest installed.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.blockMergeStep1: Set Fail CI on (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero when a finding reaches that severity.
exportWizard.blockMergeStep2: In GitHub open Settings → Branches and add a branch protection rule (or ruleset) for your base branch.
exportWizard.blockMergeStep3: Enable Require status checks to pass before merging and select the review check from this workflow.
exportWizard.blockMergeFoot: Without a required status check the review is advisory only. No GitHub App needed.
exportWizard.noRepos: Import a repository first — CI can only be added to imported repos.
exportWizard.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate the workflow? Your edits will be lost.
exportWizard.successPrBody: DevDigest committed the files to {branch} in {repo}.
exportWizard.successZipBody: Add the files to {repo} and commit them yourself.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
ciTab.title: CI deployment
ciTab.activeIn: Active in {count, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}
ciTab.failOnBody: Exit non-zero when a finding at or above this severity lands. Pair with a required status check to block merges.
ciTab.unverifiedHint: The last run executed files that differ from the installed version.
ciTab.updatedToast: Updated {count, plural, one {# installation} other {# installations}}

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
